Repository: django/django
Base commit: ddb6506618ea52c6b20e97eefad03ed847a1e3de
### Issue
Add system check for filter_horizontal/filter_vertical on ManyToManyFields with intermediary models.
Description
	
Hi team,
I'm a huge fan of Django and have been using it since 0.95 but I stumbled over this one.
Neither of
​https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/4.1/ref/contrib/admin/#django.contrib.admin.ModelAdmin.filter_horizontal and 
​https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/4.1/ref/contrib/admin/#django.contrib.admin.ModelAdmin.filter_vertical
call out the requirement to not use 
ManyToManyField(through="")
In the same way:
​https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/4.1/ref/models/fields/#django.db.models.ManyToManyField.through
doesn't call out the consequence that filter_horizontal and filter_vertical will stop working if one goes down the pathway of:
ManyToManyField(through="")
I just wasted half a day chasing this down.

### Candidate patch
```diff
diff --git a/django/contrib/admin/checks.py b/django/contrib/admin/checks.py
index 2c90dedc31..ec05e7ab6e 100644
--- a/django/contrib/admin/checks.py
+++ b/django/contrib/admin/checks.py
@@ -521,7 +521,6 @@ class BaseModelAdminChecks:
     def _check_filter_item(self, obj, field_name, label):
         """Check one item of `filter_vertical` or `filter_horizontal`, i.e.
         check that given field exists and is a ManyToManyField."""
-
         try:
             field = obj.model._meta.get_field(field_name)
         except FieldDoesNotExist:
@@ -533,6 +532,15 @@ class BaseModelAdminChecks:
                 return must_be(
                     "a many-to-many field", option=label, obj=obj, id="admin.E020"
                 )
+            elif hasattr(field, 'remote_field') and hasattr(field.remote_field, 'through') and not field.remote_field.through._meta.auto_created:
+                return [
+                    checks.Error(
+                        "The field '%s' cannot be used in 'filter_horizontal' or 'filter_vertical' "
+                        "because it has a custom through model." % field_name,
+                        obj=obj.__class__,
+                        id="admin.E021",
+                    )
+                ]
             else:
                 return []
 

```

parsed.reason: The patch adds a necessary system check for `filter_horizontal` and `filter_vertical` fields with custom through models, improving the user experience by preventing potential confusion and errors.
